---
### The Research Story `r fontawesome::fa("clock", fill="#fff", height="0.8em")` 25 min

.font90[Every research paper tells a **story** with the same parts. Each section answers **one question**:]

.pull-left[.font85[
<div class="chev-row-sm"><div class="chev-sm">1</div><div class="chev-text"><strong>Introduction</strong> &mdash; <em>Why does this matter?</em></div></div>
<div class="chev-row-sm"><div class="chev-sm">2</div><div class="chev-text"><strong>Literature Review</strong> &mdash; <em>What do we already know?</em></div></div>
<div class="chev-row-sm"><div class="chev-sm">3</div><div class="chev-text"><strong>Methods</strong> &mdash; <em>How did you study it?</em></div></div>
<div class="chev-row-sm"><div class="chev-sm">4</div><div class="chev-text"><strong>Results</strong> &mdash; <em>What did you find?</em></div></div>
]]

.pull-right[.font85[
<div class="chev-row-sm"><div class="chev-sm">5</div><div class="chev-text"><strong>Discussion</strong> &mdash; <em>What does it mean?</em></div></div>
<div class="chev-row-sm"><div class="chev-sm">6</div><div class="chev-text"><strong>Conclusion</strong> &mdash; <em>So what? What's next?</em></div></div>
<div class="chev-row-sm"><div class="chev-sm">7</div><div class="chev-text"><strong>References</strong> &mdash; <em>Whose work did you build on?</em></div></div>
]]

<div style="clear: both;"></div>

--

.content-box-yellow[
.font90[**This is what you're working toward.** We'll look at a real published student research paper &mdash; the same arc, written by people your age.]
]

# Academic Writing: <br> Style &amp; Standards `r top_icon("pen-fancy")`

---
### Academic Writing Characteristics

<div class="card-grid">
  <div class="card">
    <h4>`r fontawesome::fa("user-tie", fill = "#0148A4")` Formal Tone</h4>
    <p>Professional language &mdash; no slang or contractions. <em>"A survey was conducted"</em>, not <em>"I asked my friends."</em></p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h4>`r fontawesome::fa("scale-balanced", fill = "#0148A4")` Objective Focus</h4>
    <p>Evidence over opinion. <em>"The data suggest..."</em> instead of <em>"I think..."</em></p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h4>`r fontawesome::fa("list-check", fill = "#0148A4")` Thorough Detail</h4>
    <p>Enough information for others to replicate your work or evaluate your methods.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h4>`r fontawesome::fa("quote-right", fill = "#0148A4")` Proper Citations</h4>
    <p>Acknowledge all sources using a standard format &mdash; APA, MLA, or Chicago.</p>
  </div>
</div>

--

.content-box-blue[
.font85[**Key principles:** one idea per sentence &middot; active voice when possible &middot; precise vocabulary &middot; third person in formal writing &middot; no filler phrases.]
]

---
### Literature Review Template

.pull-left[.font80[
**Begin with a short introduction:**
- What is your topic?
- Why is it important?
- Give the broad context of the problem.

**Body:**
- Share what other studies have found.
- Organize by **themes, not by author**.

**End with a summary:**
- Summarize what was found.
- Clarify how **your** project connects to past research.
- Name the **patterns** you noticed and the **gaps** that remain.
]]

.pull-right[
<img src="assets/07-litreview.png" style="width:85%; max-height:470px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:6px;">
]

---

Rewrite each **everyday sentence** into **formal academic language**. Then compare versions as a class.

3. "Everybody knows that exercise is good for you."

5. "This study is super important and could change everything."
]

# Citing Your Sources `r top_icon("quote-right")`

---
### Why Citing Matters

.pull-left[.font90[
**What is citing?**

Citing your sources means **giving credit** to the original authors of the ideas, words, or data you use in your work.
]]

.pull-right[.font90[
**We cite to:**

- **Avoid plagiarism** &mdash; taking credit for someone else's work
- **Show where** your information came from
- **Help others find** those sources to learn more
]]

<div style="clear: both;"></div>

.content-box-yellow[
.font90[**Citing is part of being a trustworthy researcher.** It shows respect for others' work &mdash; and that you're serious about your own.]
]

---
### What to Cite &mdash; and What Not To

.pull-left[
.content-box-blue[
**`r fontawesome::fa("check", fill = "#0148A4")` You should cite:**

- Direct quotes (even short ones)
- Paraphrased ideas (someone else's idea in your own words)
- Statistics or data
- Images, charts, or graphics you didn't create
]
]

.pull-right[
.content-box-green[
**`r fontawesome::fa("xmark", fill = "#009E73")` You don't need to cite:**

- Common knowledge (e.g., "Water freezes at 0&deg;C")
- Your own original thoughts
]
]

---
### How to Cite

.font85[There are different styles (**APA, MLA, Chicago**), but the basic idea is the same: name the **author, date**, and sometimes the **page** in your text &mdash; then list the full details at the end.]

.content-box-blue[.font85[
**In-text (APA):** "Teens who sleep less are more likely to report symptoms of depression" (Williams, 2021, p. 45).

**References page:** Williams, A. (2021). *The Science of Teen Sleep.* TeenHealth Publishing.
]]

--

.font85[**For online sources, never paste a bare link &mdash; include full source info:**]

.pull-left[
.content-box-red[
**`r fontawesome::fa("xmark", fill = "#D55E00")` Not this**

.font80[`https://example.com/article`]
]
]

.pull-right[
.content-box-green[
**`r fontawesome::fa("check", fill = "#009E73")` Do this**

.font80[Smith, J. (2022). *Climate change and food security.* National Environmental Journal. https://example.com/article]
]
]

---
### Tips for Citations

<div class="card-grid">
  <div class="card">
    <h4>`r fontawesome::fa("pen-to-square", fill = "#0148A4")` Track as you go</h4>
    <p>Write down author, title, date, and link the moment you find a source.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h4>`r fontawesome::fa("hourglass-half", fill = "#0148A4")` Don't wait until the end</h4>
    <p>Build citations in as you write &mdash; not the night before it's due.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h4>`r fontawesome::fa("wand-magic-sparkles", fill = "#0148A4")` Use citation tools</h4>
    <p>EasyBib, Zotero, or the built-in Google Docs citation feature help format correctly.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h4>`r fontawesome::fa("circle-check", fill = "#0148A4")` Double-check the style</h4>
    <p>Always match your teacher's required style guide.</p>
  </div>
</div>

---

### Real-World PBL Case: Climate Science `r fontawesome::fa("fire", fill="#D55E00", height="0.8em")`

.content-box-blue[
**Does temperature rise affect wildfire frequency?**
]

.pull-left[.font85[
**The data:**
- **NOAA** temperature data
- **NIFC** wildfire data

**The analysis:**
- Run a **correlation:** is average **summer temperature** associated with **annual acres burned**?
- **Plot the trend** over **30 years**.
]]

.pull-right[.font85[
**Interpret critically:**
- Is this correlation **causal**?
- What **confounds** exist?
  - Drought
  - Forest management policy
  - Land-use changes
]]

<div style="clear: both;"></div>

.content-box-yellow[
.font90[**Correlation is not causation** &mdash; a strong association can hide a third variable driving both.]
]
